changelog: Stability: card-DB ingest and analyst-pull progress updates now lock correctly so rapid polling can't raise a dictionary-changed-size error
Stability: closing the app mid-ingest/download no longer yanks the database out from under the writer — workers get signaled to abort and are joined with a 5s timeout
Coach: per-session turn lock prevents ask/reset/close from corrupting conversation history under rapid tab switching
License: license.key now writes atomically (crash mid-write can no longer force re-activation)
License: verify errors now tell you exactly which part looks off (prefix, length, unexpected chars, checksum) instead of a generic 'check for typos'
Recovery: corrupt coach_sessions.json or license.key are moved aside to *.corrupt-<timestamp>.bak with a breadcrumb in load-errors.log, and Settings surfaces a clear warning
Build: post-build smoke-test verifies llama-cpp-python actually imports in the frozen exe — prevents regressions of the analyst-runtime bug class
